title: بصمة مغربية ورصاصة أوباميانج.. لاعب برشلونة يقضي ليلة جنونية
summary: مرتديًا القميص رقم 6 على ظهره، خاض مارك كاسادو، ظهوره الأول مع ديبورتيفو لاكورونيا، مساء السبت، في رابع جولات الدوري الإسباني، أمام فياريال.
body: مرتديًا القميص رقم 6 على ظهره، خاض مارك كاسادو، ظهوره الأول مع ديبورتيفو لاكورونيا، مساء السبت، في رابع جولات الدوري الإسباني، أمام فياريال. ودخل كاسادو، الذي يلعب على سبيل الإعارة من برشلونة، كبديل في الدقيقة 66 في اللقاء الذي انتهى بفوز قاتل لناديه الجديد، بنتيجة 3-2. وذكرت صحيفة سبورت ، أن كاسادو نزل أرضية ملعب لا سيراميكا، عندما كانت النتيجة تشير إلى التعادل 1-1، وكان فياريال، مندفعًا بالكامل نحو الهجوم.  وتمركز كاسادو في محور الارتكاز المزدوج إلى جانب أماتوتشي، وكان موفقًا في تدخلاته بالكرة، وملتزمًا كعادته بالجهود الدفاعية، بل إنه تمكن حتى من التصدي لتسديدة خطيرة، كما لم يرتكب أي أخطاء. وجاء ظهور كاسادو الأول، في ليلة شهدت جنونًا حقيقيًا، فقد حالف أداما تراوري، سوء الحظ، وسجل هدفًا عكسيًا في مرماه، بعد محاولة لإبعاد الكرة برأسه، ليتقدم فياريال بنتيجة 2-1. لكن المغربي زكريا الدهشوري، سجل هدف التعادل للضيوف في الدقيقة 79، من صناعة الجابوني أوباميانج، الذي سجل بنفسه هدف الفوز لصالح ديبورتيفو لاكورونيا في الدقيقة 88. وارتفع رصيد ديبورتيفو لاكورونيا إلى 8 نقاط في المركز الرابع، فيما تجمد رصيد فياريال عند نقطتين في المرتبة 16. يمكنكم مناقشة الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة

Jackson NASA Headquarters building in Washington NASA/Joel Kowsky On Wednesday, June 17, skywatchers across the United States—and parts of Canada—enjoyed a rare event: a daytime lunar occultation of Venus. A lunar occultation occurs when the Moon moves directly in front of another celestial object from our viewpoint on Earth, briefly hiding it from sight. This time, the Moon slipped in front of Venus for the first of three occultations happening this year, creating a striking daylight moment for those who caught it. We’ve seen screens fold, twist, and even stretch vertically, and at IFA 2026 , the company is experimenting with another idea: What if your regular 14-inch laptop could suddenly give you a much wider screen when you need it? title: You can now talk your way through Gmail, Docs, and Keep
summary: Gemini can now turn your voice into answers, documents, and organized notes.
body: TL;DR Gmail, Docs, and Keep can now understand natural voice commands and turn them into useful actions. Docs Live can pull info from Gmail, Drive, Chat, and the web, while Keep Live organizes free-flowing thoughts into notes and lists. The new voice features are rolling out now to eligible Google AI subscribers, with Workspace support coming soon. Back at Google I/O, the company showed how Gemini could make Gmail, Docs, and Keep feel less like apps you operate and more like assistants you talk to. The company promised that these new voice-powered experiences would be available this summer, and after a few early glimpses , the wait is finally over. Gmail Live, Docs Live, and Keep Live are rolling out now, giving users new ways to get things done without reaching for the keyboard. Gmail Live is perhaps the most immediately useful of the three. Instead of digging through your inbox or remembering the right keywords, you can ask a question out loud. Gmail can connect information across emails to synthesize an answer. That could mean asking when your kid’s next school event is, checking an order update, or finding information buried across multiple messages.

title: Aurzen’s pocket-sized folding projector gets a Pro upgrade
summary: Aurzen took its coolest projector and made it better.
body: TL;DR Aurzen’s new ZIP Pro builds on the original folding projector with native 1080p resolution, 200 ANSI lumens, and a larger 38Wh battery. The tri-fold projector packs a big-screen experience into a pocketable, 586g design roughly the size of a large power bank. New features include a built-in touchscreen display, dual Bluetooth headphone support, Nintendo Switch projection, and 2.5 hours of playback in ECO mode. We’ve learned to accept that in tech, anything portable will have compromises compared to its tethered counterpart — except phones , of course. Laptops are generally less powerful than desktops, wireless earbuds have the battery constraints that wired earbuds don’t, and projectors are no different. The smaller projectors get, the more features consumers tend to lose, such as brightness, resolution, battery life, and more. Aurzen knows that, and instead of trying to replace your living-room TV, the company’s new projector goes all in on making the big-screen experience as portable as possible.

body: A SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket launches with NASA’S Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope onboard from Launch Complex 39A on Aug. 30, 2026, at Kennedy Space Center in Florida. NASA/Joel Kowsky Now on a three-month, million-mile journey to its final orbit, NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will soon reveal the universe’s darkest secrets. The mission launched at 7:26 a.m. EDT on Aug. 30 aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Launch Complex 39A at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Roman pairs a large field of view with crisp infrared vision to explore vast swaths of the sky and probe deeply into cosmic history. This flagship mission will help astronomers explore dark matter, dark energy, and worlds outside of our solar system, known as exoplanets. Roman is the fourth primary mission NASA has launched on a Falcon Heavy rocket. Earlier this year, the agency’s Launch Services Program worked with SpaceX to accelerate the launch date to accommodate the space telescope’s early completion.
